1. Update the game title interface
2. Fully optimize the game and fix several bugs
3. The number of attacks with all exclusive and universal weapons has increased (1-3). After completing the level once, players can restart the game and purchase from various weapon stores
4. Add three more challenging levels of difficulty, with stronger enemy abilities, higher experience, money, and explosion rate; After completing the level once, restart the game and chat with NPC "Little Fatty Ball" next to the Goddess Statue in Qingquan Village to increase three new additional difficulties
(Friends who have already completed the game before this update need to read the final ending save, after watching the ending, refresh the game ending rating again in order to update 3 or 4 new content.)
5. Modify certain typos
6. Fix the issue of metal character errors for Ruby trainers in the Alubi Studio
